# EXP-0003 roofline / bottleneck summary (generated by analysis/flextern_roofline.py; do not hand-edit)

Everything below is ANALYTICAL / INFERRED under the abstract assumptions in `assumptions.json`. Workload inputs are MEASURED (EXP-0002/EXP-0002B). No hardware was measured; no tokens/sec figure is a measurement.

Default abstract assumptions: 250 GB/s, 4096 terms/cycle @ 1 GHz (4.096e12 terms/s), 1e12 non-ternary op-eq/s, BF16 head and KV, 2-bit weights, dense execution, batch 1, context 4096.

## 6. Break-even: ternary stage compute vs weight bandwidth (batch 1, 2-bit)

terms/s to saturate BW = BW × 4 × B; BW to feed an engine = rate/(4·B); lanes at BW and clock = BW·4·B/f; batch to balance = rate/(4·BW).
